channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Oct 05
item.description:
64 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Projectiles no longer persist after a player’s base is destroyed, preventing stray ammunition from lingering.

Base & Infrastructure

  • Softcore servers now limit players to three Tool Cupboards, with an on‑screen icon and toast notification when the limit is reached.

Power & Fuel

  • Biofuel generators only draw electricity while actively producing fuel, eliminating idle power drain.

Livestock & Trading

  • Livestock age now progresses correctly, fixing a regression that could make animals appear younger after maturing.
  • Lead rope now breaks at 15 m (up from 7 m), and animals display familiarity and gender by default.
  • Selling previously bought or found animals to the livestock vendor now incurs an 85 % penalty, up from 20 %.

Combat & Projectiles

  • Projectiles no longer persist after a player’s base is destroyed, preventing stray ammunition from lingering.

Server & Authentication

  • The server now ignores redundant authentication messages after a player is already authenticated, avoiding unnecessary re‑auth rejections.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Added an underwear clothing category and refreshed the character creator layout, giving players more customization options.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Oct 04
item.description:
13 development commits

Softcore Mode

  • Fixed death screen on first softcore join; players now spawn directly at the beach.

Research & Crafting

  • Research tables can now be used to research Animal Fence and Gate.

Farming & Food

  • Milk can be stacked when the skim timer is under 1 minute, and skimming works even if food spoiling is disabled.

Vehicles

  • Scrap helicopter dismount points adjusted to avoid always ejecting players from the front.
